content:
alex: quick check — I noticed the staging proxy logs show an `x-prompt-tokens` header for some requests to dedicated clusters. can we confirm whether that header (and token counts) are being redacted before logs are shipped?

maria: thanks for flagging. which proxy/service is this? dedicated-proxy or the edge gateway?

alex: looks like `dedicated-proxy-01` (pod named `dedicated-proxy-01-5f8b`). sample line:```INFO request id=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/generate headers={\"x-prompt-tokens\":\"4212\", \"authorization\":\"Bearer ****\"} body={...}```

sec-bot: automated alert: potential sensitive-header exposure detected in logs for service `dedicated-proxy-01` at 2026-03-17T09:12:34Z. recommended action: mask numeric token headers and strip raw prompt bodies.

sam: oh hmm. we intentionally kept token count header for routing heuristics, but that shouldn't be in persisted logs. looks like a recent config drift in our log formatter.

priya: agreed — token counts are low-risk but still metadata we don't need in ELK. request/response bodies definitely must be scrubbed. can we add a transform in the proxy that redacts: `x-prompt-tokens`, `x-session-id`, and any header matching `x-user-*`?

alex: proposed quick plan: 1) roll a hotfix to redaction in dedicated-proxy log formatter (mask headers and drop bodies) 2) update central logging pipeline to scrub headers server-side 3) add an alert/flag in sec-bot if sensitive headers appear again. i'll open a PR in a few minutes.

maria: SGTM. please include a test that asserts the formatted log does not contain numeric token strings. also add a comment in the config explaining why we drop `x-prompt-tokens`.

sam: tagging infra-ops for a patch rollout window — prefer low-traffic window tonight. cc @priya for review.

priya: i can review the PR. quick question: do we need to preserve token counts for autoscaling metrics? if so, we should send them to metricsd over UDP instead of into logs.

alex: good call. we can emit a counter metric `prompts.tokens` to prometheus and remove the header from logs. that keeps telemetry without PII risk.

sec-bot: note recorded: policy "log-redaction-v2" recommends metrics-only for token counts. file an incident if this appears in prod logs after rollout.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dedicated-proxy/pull/482 — includes formatter change + unit test + a `metricsd` emit for token counts. marking this thread for follow-up after rollout. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will monitor ELK and confirm no appearance in the last 24h after deploy. :eyes:

sam: deploying in the 23:00 UTC window. i'll post deploy bot updates.

alex: thanks everyone. if anyone sees the header reappear ping me and i'll rollback the change.
